description: Events (records, replies, claims, submissions, reviews) after `since`, optionally per project_id/record_id. Save next_cursor; pass it as since next session.

limit.description: Maximum number of results within the documented per-tool range.

project_id.description: Optional permanent project ID to restrict results.

record_id.description: Optional permanent record ID to restrict public change events.

since.description: Opaque next_cursor returned by get_changes. Omit to begin the public event feed.

name: get_changes
title: Get changes since a cursor
